n1.text: Is the failed motor 215 frame size or smaller?

r_big.cause: The no-fault warranty covers only motors up to and including 215 frame.
fix: Any motor above 215 frame must be inspected.
Contact WEG directly at (800) 839-2529 or warranty@weg.net.

n2.text: Is it a Hydro-Duty, Picker Plus or Hydro-Wash motor?

r_excl.cause: Those motors are not part of the no-fault warranty policy.
fix: Contact the WEG Warranty Department at (800) 839-2529 for instructions.

n3.text: Did the motor fail within its specified warranty period (see the WEG catalog), and is this the first no-fault claim for this end user and this application?

r_no.cause: No-fault credit is offered one time per end user per application and only within the warranty period.
fix: Check the WEG catalog warranty policy or call WEG warranty at (800) 839-2529 about other options.

r_claim.cause: The motor qualifies to submit a no-fault claim.
fix: Complete the form: date of request, WEG invoice or customer PO number, contact information and a description of the issue.
Tape the original nameplate from the failed motor to the form and mail it to WEG Electric Corp., ATTN: Warranty Department, 6655 Sugarloaf Parkway, Duluth, GA 30097.
Credit is for the motor only (excluding freight) to the account of the original purchaser.
